testCase.name: [dev] S13 Switching care setting, deep links and reload: each dashboard lists only its own patient, with no junk and no stuck loading

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S13 「切换模式、直接链接和刷新：每个 dashboard 只列它自己的病人，没有垃圾，加载不卡住」 Switching care setting, deep links and reload: each dashboard lists only its own patient, with no junk and no stuck loading

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 With patients in a mix of pending / in-progress / complete states, the dashboard counts (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) match the real patient-list state, in Hospital and in Nursing Home（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • U2 The dashboard is present (reachable from the patient list) and correct in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Standard fixture: the resident has no unit stored; the Hospital patient has a room

When Open the Hospital dashboard; go back, switch to Nursing Home, open its dashboard; go back, switch to Hospital, open its dashboard again. Then navigate straight to /snf/dashboard and reload; navigate straight to /rounding/dashboard and reload

Then Each dashboard lists only its own care setting's patient, every time, with no leftover from the previous screen. After each reload it loads its own patient again. No blank screen, no stuck loading or 'being updated' text, and no 'undefined', 'null' or 'NaN' where the unit is missing. Total 1 on each once the counts check lands

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: every checkpoint mustContain 'Rounding Dashboard' (the url check is a no-op, runnerNotes.url) and its own patient, and mustNotContain the other care setting's patient, 'Loading rounding status' and 'being updated'. The two reload checkpoints also mustNotContain 'undefined', 'null' and 'NaN'. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
